comment: Models for `python bench/run.py --provider openrouter --models default`. Edit freely: any OpenRouter model id works (`python bench/models.py claude` searches the live list, `python bench/models.py --check` verifies that every id below still exists). Use concrete ids, not the moving `~vendor/...-latest` aliases, so that a result file says what was measured.
presets_comment: Named bundles for `--preset NAME`: the models for each provider, and the settings of a run. A preset only fills in what the command line leaves out (--models, --samples, --tier win). `cheap`: Claude Haiku 4.5 and Sonnet 5.5 (through the Anthropic API or OpenRouter) and the two cheap OpenRouter models of the list above, 5 samples of every task of the v2 tier, so that every number gets an interval.
